Players Committee card image of [[Anakin Skywalker (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1; the same image re-uploaded as a full-size GIF, recorded with that version, not as a separate version; errata mark “E”), printing: “USED: Unless Twilight Is Upon Me on table, ▲ [Cloud City] or [Endor] Leia or [Dagobah] Luke. LOST: During a battle at a site involving [Endor] Leia or [Dagobah] or [Death Star II] Luke, choose: Add one destiny to attrition. OR Cancel the game text of a character of ability < 4.” Uploaded unchanged.
